Name: (CP) Creepy Forest Druid Rasmodius
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Tahoma][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Tahoma]
It's the beginning of the Halloween season and I thought, what better way to kick it off than making a spooky portrait mod for Stardew Valley![font=Tahoma] For a guy that stays hidden away in a tower in the middles of the woods brewing strange potions that make you hallucinate trees, the vanilla wizard does not nearly look weird and gross enough.[/font] This mod fixes that, changing the Wizard's portraits and sprites into a new, creepier, weirder version fitting for the season.

Currently does not include any seasonal variations but I may be open to the possibility in the future if there is enough positive feedback at launch.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
This mod can be installed like normal, by downloading, unzipping, and dropping into your Mods folder. Can be added or removed at any time.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Romanceable Rasmodius (both normal and SVE-compatible versions), and Looking for Love, which all add new sprites and portraits for the Wizard. It will automatically detect whether you are using any of these mods and apply the necessary changes accordingly.
[b]
[u][color=#ffd966]IMPORTANT![/color][/u][/b] If you are using the [b]either version of[/b] [b]Romanceable Rasmodius[/b], you may have to do extra setup. If this mod detects that you have either version of RomRas, it will load the version of the Wizard's portrait sheet that has nine expressions. If you previously had RomRas configured to use a different amount of portraits, you will have to change that in the config for [i]RomRas[/i], not my own mod.

Currently not compatible with Romanceable Rasmodia. If there is enough interest, I will consider making new female portraits and sprites for that.

Not compatible with Romanceable Rasmodious Redux Revamp (RRRR). I currently have no plans or interest to try to adapt my design to that mod, so do not ask.
[/font]

Manifest.Name: Creepy Forest Druid Rasmodius
Manifest.Description: Gives the wizard some new portraits and sprites that reimagine him as a creepy forest druid.
Manifest.Author: Vinilla
